video_title: Richard Jefferson Says Miami Can Contend With Anyone if Klay Stays Hot

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Klay Thompson has found his niche with the Miami Heat
quotes.excerpt: he's found his niche. You could tell when a basketball player is in a safe place
quotes.quote: They play a style of play that is just their style. They want to get out, they want to run, they want to play isolation. They want Giannis Antetokounmpo and Bam Adebayo to be able to have driving gaps and all of a sudden you see Klay Thompson get to light up and shooting those threes and knocking them down consistently. He's found his niche. You could tell when a basketball player is in a safe place, he's in that space right now. He's in that zone. He feels comfortable because even when the numbers don't reflect on the box score, Klay Thompson, Ray Allen, Stephen Curry, those guys, even Reggie Miller, when they're on the floor, even if they don't score a bucket, they're still a decoy. You still have to respect them.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Giannis Antetokounmpo has added a mid-range game to his arsenal
quotes.excerpt: Giannis added the mid-range to his game. I believe he's like 38 for 48 from the mid-range
quotes.quote: By the way, Giannis Antetokounmpo, not just how dominant he's been, but Giannis added the mid-range to his game. I believe he's like 38 for 48 from the mid-range jump shot. Mid-range, that's good. It makes him harder to guard, which is scary.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Klay Thompson's shooting gravity forces defenders to follow him everywhere
quotes.excerpt: If Klay leaves the building and walks in the hallway, his defender is going to go there too
quotes.quote: When we spoke with Erik Spoelstra, he was like, look, Klay cannot hit a shot. If Klay leaves the building and walks in the hallway, his defender is going to go there too. And that's the truth. That's the truth. That wherever he goes, you just going to go with him. Klay, I don't care where you're going, I'm not going to get in trouble. So when I look at Klay's performance, and that's the one area everyone said, can they shoot? That was what everybody said. Will they shoot? Will they have the space? Yes, it was some Bam and Giannis, how they're going to fit, but it was like, will they have enough shots? And Klay has his best shooting start that he's ever had to his career. That equates to eight and two in your last ten.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: The Miami Heat are showing defensive improvement as a team
quotes.excerpt: defensively they're a lot better. They're making better decisions defense. They're not great, but they're better
quotes.quote: Defensively they're a lot better. They're making better decisions defense. They're not great, but they're better. They are obviously better, they're eight and two. They were better, they were better. They were a work in progress. Now, do I feel like, and here's the thing that Richard said we're not going to talk about, I'm going to talk about. Do I think that they could sustain this? I don't know. But when you have Bam, Giannis, and Klay, you're going to go on these runs that are going to keep you in the game even if your defense isn't elite, it's just not ass. You don't got to be ass.

quotes.speaker: Allie Clifton
quotes.summary_phrase: Miami Heat defensive rating has improved during their winning streak
quotes.excerpt: They have the 26th ranked defensive rating. However, over their five game winning streak, they have the 10th
quotes.quote: They have the 26th ranked defensive rating. However, over their five game winning streak, they have the 10th best.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Miami is a championship contender with a top-ten defense
quotes.excerpt: if you have a top offense and a top-ten defense, you are a contender by statistics
quotes.quote: If you have a top offense and a top-ten defense, you are a contender by statistics across the board.
